verdict.rationale: Sentry's first-party Agents Dashboards show model costs and token usage, with a Model Cost widget that estimates cost from tokens and model pricing. The LLM Calls view shows individual model requests, so cost and tokens can be compared per request and across models. The evidence does not document breaking cost or token usage down by time period, and there is no independent corroboration. Missing for 10: documented per-time-period cost/token breakdowns, independent or hands-on corroboration of cost dashboard accuracy.

support.subject: As a developer, I can see cost and token usage per request, model, and time period in dashboards

citations.quote: **LLM Calls** shows individual model requests. Use it to compare models, prompts, token usage, cost, and response performance
